correctness.rationale: The source identifies a rational unibranch infinity point with local coordinates w/t,u/t,1/t and pole orders. For homogeneous polynomial degree n, the numerator space is exactly k + phi*k[x] of bounded degree 3n-2, giving degree-n valuations E_n. Equal-parity E_n from different n first overlap strictly beyond the conductor of H=<m,m+2,m+6>, so no new values below the conductor are possible. The Apéry set gives the exact delta and conductor. A standalone finite arithmetic script passed for n<=17 and genera g<=100, diagnostic only.
